prompt:
Repair the credit_rollup package's CSV transaction report. Public API: credit_rollup.rollup(source), where source is a text stream opened with newline="" (StringIO is supported), consumes from its current position and returns a JSON-ready dict; do not close it. No filesystem or CLI API is required. Keep the multi-module package and update its README.

The first CSV record must be exactly account,currency,kind,amount,memo in that order, with no BOM or whitespace normalization in the header. Empty input and any other header raise RowError(0, 1, "expected header account,currency,kind,amount,memo"). Use standard comma/double-quote CSV, including escaped quotes, embedded commas and embedded newlines. Reject malformed quoting using csv.reader(strict=True). Ignore completely blank records ([]), but not records containing empty fields. Each nonblank data record must have exactly five fields. Strip account, currency, kind and amount; memo is ignored. Account must be nonempty; currency must be exactly three ASCII uppercase letters; kind is sale or refund. Amount must match ASCII digits with an optional decimal point followed by one or two digits, be unsigned, and be at most 999999999999.99. Zero, leading zeroes, and single decimal digits are allowed. Exponents, signs, NaN, Infinity, underscores, Unicode digits and extra decimal places are invalid. Use Decimal, not binary float, for money parsing; no rounding away fractional cents. Results must remain exact even if the caller changes decimal context precision.

Expose credit_rollup.RowError as a ValueError subclass with integer record and line attributes and a reason string. str(error) is exactly "record {record}, line {line}: {reason}". Data records are numbered from 1, counting only nonblank records after the header; line is the 1-based physical START line of the offending record (including preceding blank lines and embedded newlines). Fail on the first bad record. Validation order/reasons: wrong field count -> "expected 5 fields"; empty account -> "account is empty"; invalid currency -> "invalid currency"; invalid kind -> "invalid kind"; invalid/out-of-range amount -> "invalid amount". A csv.Error in a data record becomes RowError with the next nonblank record number, its physical start line and reason "invalid CSV"; malformed header CSV uses record 0, line 1, reason "invalid CSV".

Return exactly {"groups": [...], "totals": {...}}. Group by normalized (account, currency), ordered lexicographically by account then currency (case-sensitive Python string ordering). Each group has account, currency, count, sales, refunds, net. Totals has count, sales, refunds, net (no account/currency). count includes sales, refunds and zero amounts. sales and refunds are nonnegative sums of their respective kinds; net = sales - refunds. All monetary values are strings with exactly two fractional digits, no exponent, and no negative zero. Totals combine all currencies without conversion, intentionally. Header-only/blank-data input returns no groups and zero totals. Output must contain only JSON-compatible primitives. Preserve the public import, add regression tests, and keep existing tests working. Run tests with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
